chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad, from al-Washa, from Aban, from Zurara, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said upon the pulpit: 'None of you will find the taste of faith until he knows that what hit him would not have missed him, and what missed him would not have hit him.'
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for finding the 'taste of faith' according to Imam Ali?
ai.summary: This hadith, transmitted through the chain of Zurarah to Imam al-Sadiq, anchors the believer's spiritual peace in the conviction of divine decree (al-Qada' wa al-Qadar), a foundational tenet in Shia theology. It emphasizes that true 'taste' of faith requires internalizing that every event, whether perceived as gain or loss, is precisely what Allah intended, thereby transforming passive acceptance into active spiritual certainty.
